entries.zh: 走到这一边去；站避一旁
entries.en: to step aside to this side; to move off to one side
to part from one another; to scatter apart, disperse
to part from one another; to be separated from each other

entries.zh: 拆散；使分离（拆开成对或成群的）
entries.en: to break apart; to split up (a pair, a company)
to split apart; to come apart and go separate ways
to part deliberately, of set purpose; to split into separate pieces
to break away; to detach, come off

entries.zh: 修道；出家修行，脱离尘俗（入会修行）
entries.en: to withdraw from the world into religious life; to cultivate the religious way
entries.notes: 西语栏尾部 sid 为未展开缩写或衍文，不影响脩道（入教修行）核心义。

entries.en: to step back aside; to withdraw to one side
to drag apart; to pull away by dragging

entries.zh: 非理；违背道理，悖理而行
entries.en: to depart from reason; unreasonable, contrary to reason

entries.zh: 非义；违背道义，行事不义
entries.en: to depart from what is just; contrary to righteousness
separate, apart; another

entries.zh: 另居；分居别处，独自另住
entries.en: to live apart; to dwell separately on one's own

entries.zh: 走样；偏离正道常态，失去原样
entries.en: to deviate from the proper way or manner; to lose its proper shape
entries.notes: 西语栏抄写讹误（delos buen…delos modos 重复叠置），据走样义推断其意为偏离正道。

entries.en: to remove; to cast out, expel
to break off friendship; to sever ties
to go far away; to part and take leave

entries.zh: 远弃；疏远弃绝，断交远去
entries.en: to forsake and cast off; to estrange and break off ties

entries.zh: 出头占取；热衷出头，争先占据某物
entries.en: to be passionately eager for something, vying to claim it for oneself
entries.notes: 西语栏缩写 gst 未展开，义项据汉字「出头占伊」推断为出头争占。

entries.en: for frost to fall; frost, hoarfrost
entries.notes: 西语词头栏空白，据汉字与 M/R 音读定为下霜义，西语原词无从互证，故列低置信。

entries.zh: 下雹；冰雹砸落（雹如投石）
entries.en: for hail to fall; to hail, pelt as with stones
to appeal (to a higher court); to sue, lodge a complaint
